the effects of prenatal exposure to interleukins (ILs), which are cytokines produced by the mother during pregnancy.
the effects of maternal inflammatory response and cytokines on the fetus, which may contribute to cardiovascular and endocrine diseases in adulthood.
the effects of early life stress on the development of cardiovascular and neuroendocrinological diseases later in life.
